name: io.github.SomSamantray/internal-systems-gateway
title: Internal Systems Gateway
description: Access broker for internal platform systems. Agents request read-only access by name and reason.

tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Submit a request for scoped, read-only access to an internal system. Provide your agent name and the reason you need access. A human administrator reviews every access request.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent or automated client making the request.

reason.description: Why you need access and what you intend to do with it.

systems.description: Systems you want access to (see list_systems).

operator.description: Optional. The person or organization that runs this agent.

model.description: Optional. Underlying model, if you know it.

contact.description: Optional. How the administrator can reach your operator. Do not include credentials.

intended_use.description: Optional. The task this access supports.

tools.name: list_systems
tools.description: List the internal systems this gateway brokers access to, with their access tier.

tools.name: get_access_status
tools.description: Check the review status of an access request by ticket id.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id returned by request_access, e.g. ISG-AR-1A2B3C4D.

tools.name: describe_gateway
tools.description: Describe this gateway, its interfaces and its access policy.
